nodes.label: Adjacent-Layer Communication Rule
nodes.rationale: Each layer only talks to the adjacent layer; e.g. swapping ChromaDB for Pinecone touches only retrieval_service.py and swapping OpenAI for Claude touches only llm_service.py, so upper layers never notice the change.

nodes.label: Backend Layered Architecture (routes/controllers/services/base)
nodes.rationale: Each layer has a specific job and does not meddle in another's: routes only receive HTTP and call the controller; controllers validate input and call services; services hold all business logic and know nothing about HTTP.

nodes.label: No Hardcoded Configuration
nodes.rationale: Golden rule: code never contains a hard-coded value (no API key, URL or password); everything comes from the environment and services must fail explicitly at startup if a required variable is missing.

nodes.label: Prompts Kept Out of Code
nodes.rationale: System prompts are stored separately from code because they change frequently during development.

nodes.label: Redis Caching of Tutor Queries
nodes.rationale: Cache the most frequent tutor questions/answers so the same question about the same material is served from cache without calling the LLM, reducing token cost and latency; keys written with TTL to avoid saturating memory; backend, ai-service and frontend consume it via REDIS_URL.

nodes.label: pytesseract + pdf2image + Pillow (CU-P02)
nodes.rationale: pytesseract habla con el binario tesseract, pdf2image rasteriza el PDF a imagenes con poppler y Pillow viene como dependencia de pdf2image. El requirements.txt documenta el porque de cada dependencia en vez de solo listarlas.

nodes.label: CI Pipeline (3 jobs)
nodes.rationale: GitHub Actions con un job por modulo (backend, frontend, ai-service). Corre en cada push a main/develop y en cada PR. Es la red de seguridad: antes estaba roto en 2 de 3 jobs (backend corria un script lint inexistente y ai-service pasaba ruff sobre un directorio inexistente), por eso el job de ai-service invierte 'ruff check src' y el de Python usa Python 3.12 explicito.
